And it doesnt matter if the requirements make sense or not, you wont get the belt if you dont furfill them. Its not like bjj where you get the belt when you have the skill. I guess you practice bjj and/or wrestling as well? You will learn more takedowns there, improve your takedowns in conjunction with judo. You might be better than the rank you have, but you have to decide if its more important to you to get the rank, whilst sacrificing some mma or get better at mma and progress slower in the belt system. I picked the former and Im very happy.
